tools.name: catnip_run
tools.description: Run the full catnip pipeline: fetch -> analyze -> history -> totals -> verify. Measured at 41 minutes for 111 repos; the fetch is serial so it grows with the account.

tools.name: catnip_verify
tools.description: Assert every analysis CSV the TUI requires exists and is non-empty. Exits non-zero if any is missing.

tools.name: catnip_store_status
tools.description: Print the durable store's schema version, owner, newest day, coverage ranges and repo count as JSON. This is the authority on whether a run actually refreshed the data.
args: catnip config --json | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['paths']['history_file'])" | xargs -r python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));days=sorted({x for r in d.get('repos',{}).values() for m in ('clones','views') for x in (r.get(m) or {})});print(json.dumps({'schema_version':d.get('schema_version'),'owner':d.get('owner'),'updated':d.get('updated'),'latest_day':days[-1] if days else None,'coverage':d.get('coverage'),'repos':len(d.get('repos',{})),'paths_repos':len(d.get('paths',{}))}))"

tools.name: catnip_report_write
tools.description: Write the deterministic markdown report for the durable store. Refuses and exits non-zero when the store's newest day has not advanced since the last report - that refusal is a correct outcome, not a failure.

tools.name: catnip_report_read
tools.description: Print the deterministic report to stdout without writing it. Never gated by the interval guard. This is the measured floor every prowl finding must rest on.

tools.name: catnip_report_meta
tools.description: Print the newest written report's meta.json (latest_day, written, provenance) - the authority on whether a report exists for the current store.
args: d=$(catnip config --json | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['paths']['data_dir'])")/reports; ls -1d "$d"/*/ 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1 | xargs -r -I{} cat {}meta.json 2>/dev/null || echo none

tools.name: catnip_view
tools.description: Print one derived view as text. Every number is computed by catnip.derive from the durable store, so anything it returns is measured.

tools.name: catnip_derivation
tools.description: Print the formula, thresholds and inputs behind one view - the same text the TUI's [?] overlay shows. Use it before asserting what a number means.

tools.name: catnip_store_series
tools.description: Print one repo's daily clones and views from the durable store as JSON, for testing a hypothesis against the raw series rather than against a rendered view.
args: h=$(catnip config --json | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['paths']['history_file'])"); python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));r=(d.get('repos') or {}).get(sys.argv[2]);print(json.dumps(r if r else {'error':'no such repo in store','known':sorted(d.get('repos',{}))[:40]}))" "$h" "$1"

tools.name: catnip_prowl_finding
tools.description: Append ONE finding to this cycle's prowl file. `tier` is constrained to measured|inferred|speculative and `evidence` must name the tool call that supports it - a finding cannot be recorded without both.

tools.name: catnip_prowl_refuted
tools.description: Record a hypothesis that did NOT hold. A prowl cycle with no refutations is a cycle that did not actually test anything.
args: mkdir -p .state/prowl && printf -- '- %s - checked with %s; did not hold: %s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> ".state/prowl/$4.refuted.md" && echo recorded

tools.name: catnip_prowl_publish
tools.description: Assemble this cycle's recorded findings into prowl.md beside the deterministic report.md, and print the result path plus a per-tier count. Fails if no findings were recorded.

tools.name: write_state
tools.description: Write content to a .state/ file path

tools.name: read_state
tools.description: Read a value from a .state/ file. Returns "none" with exit code 1 if the file does not exist.
